observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor public gathering area on packed dirt, with seated onlookers and musicians in the background
observation.dancers: mixed group of adult men and women dancing in couples
observation.formation_and_space: couples dancing in a small informal circle or cluster in an open space
observation.posture: upright torso, slight knee bend, weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: step-touch or rhythmic stepping in place on the beat, feet stay close to the ground
observation.arms_and_hands: closed dance hold with arms framing the partner, one hand on partner's waist/shoulder and free hand held
observation.hips_and_torso: subtle hip movement and weight shifts synchronized with the partner
observation.partnering: closed couple dance with continuous contact, lead and follow in framing
observation.levels_jumps_turns: grounded steps, occasional light turns without jumps
observation.costume_and_props: casual everyday clothing: shirts, trousers, skirts, caps
observation.cannot_infer: low video resolution and frequent camera framing changes obscure precise weight transfer mechanics and individual foot placement

signature_moments.what: couples dancing in closed hold with rhythmic side-to-side stepping and hip movement
partner turning smoothly while maintaining closed hold
